container: padding-left/right clamp(24px, 4vw, 80px); section variant padding 200px top/bottom

ease.easeOutSlow: referenced by slide-up in-view; value not captured (GAP)

fluid_unit: custom fx suffix (4fx radius, 20fx/40fx/90fx spacing) — numeric scale TBD

hover_restraint.card: desktop hover shadow 0 0 74.4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) — ambient lift, no glow

reduced_motion_css: ONLY 2 narrow rules in theme CSS (manual rail animation:none; motion-reduce utility). No global kill switch in CSS -> Accessibility Mode toggle must act via JS/class (see live test 2026-09-13).

reveal.menu: mirrored in/out pairs: --animation-delay-in 0.1/0.2/0.3s vs --animation-delay-out 0.3/0.2/0.1s; panel translate duration 0.8s
reveal.scale-out: initial scale(1.2) will-change:transform; .in-view -> scale(1), transition all 2.3s var(--delay) easeOut; used on model spot-art imgs with 0.1-0.4s stagger
reveal.slide-up: initial opacity 0 translateY(20%); .in-view -> opacity 1 translateY(0), transition duration var(--animation-duration, default 1.8s) delay var(--animation-delay) easeOutSlow, properties opacity+transform only

section_theme_morph: inline: transition background-color 1.1s var(--alias-easeOut), color 1.1s var(--alias-easeOut) — slow 1.1s band recolor on scroll
